sources.what: Price plan cards, read in the built-in browser 2 Nov
12M EMA fact sheet linked from the card (new version, Oct 2026)
24M EMA fact sheet linked from the card (new version, Oct 2026)

plans.name: 24M Fixed Price Plan

terms.deposit_source: For new Sembcorp Customer, you are not required to pay Security Deposit during your application. If you are a non-existing Customer with SP Services Ltd, the Security Deposit will be collected in your first consolidated invoice, amount determined by SP Services Ltd. For existing Customer with SP Services Ltd, you are not required to provide additional Security Deposit. Customer renewing with Sembcorp Power, should there be any top-up of Security Deposit due to consolidated billing with SP Services Ltd, there will be a Security Deposit recovery charge reflected in your SP Services Ltd invoice.
terms.etf_source: A) Early Termination Charge (“ETC”): ETC = Termination Rate x Unexpired Months i) Termination Rate for each Household Type as shown below ii) Unexpired Months refers to the number of months (inclusive of month at the date of termination) between the date of termination and the date the Contract Term would otherwise have expired. [table, an image in the fact sheet, transcribed:] Residence Type | Termination Rate ($/month) | HDB 1 Room 10 | HDB 2 Room 15 | HDB 3 Room 20 | HDB 4 Room 30 | HDB 5 Room 35 | HDB Executive 40 | Private Apartment 40 | Terrace 70 | Semi-Detached 95 | Bungalow 200 | b) ETC not applicable in the event of re-location supported by reasonable documentary evidence

plans.evidence: 24M Fixed Price Plan 24 Month 30.90c/kWh -(w/ GST)- Fact Sheet 28.35cents/kWh (w/o GST) || Fact sheet: Fixed Price Plan: 30.90 cents/kWh (after GST)
plans.notes: PRICE CHANGE: was 29.00c/kWh. Plan card read in the built-in browser 2 Nov; the new EMA fact sheet it links (version date 2026-10-23) says the same. Card label now 'Exclusive Rate'. No promotion shown on the card. Deposit and ETF unchanged (ETF table is an image in the fact sheet; read visually, identical in both plans' fact sheets).
